title: Export a Google Sheets tab as PDF with AI
h1: make a pdf of the google sheets tab you chose
description: Ask a bot to export one Google Sheets tab or rectangular range as PDF. Set orientation and gridlines, then check the layout before sharing the file.
keyword: google sheets export pdf with ai
keywords: chatgpt export google sheet to pdf
ai google sheets range to pdf
answer: a bot can render one google sheets tab, or a rectangular part of it, as a pdf with choices such as portrait orientation, gridlines and fit to width. give it the sheet's link and say which tab. dusk bot counts this export as a change, so the bot needs read and write for sheets, even though your sheet isn't touched.
og_line: a pdf from the tab you actually need.
what:
export sheet as pdf is for a chosen tab or rectangle rather than an unspecified workbook. paste the normal link to the sheet and name the tab; the bot works out the rest.

you can request orientation, margins, sheet names and repeated frozen rows. google doesn't document some print settings, like margins, so open the pdf and check it before you share it. fit to width alone is not proof that every page will be easy to read.
uses: make a printable duty roster from one tab without exposing the budget tabs
export the approved quote rectangle for an internal review
prepare a landscape copy of a wide workshop attendance table
create a gridline-free pdf of a small totals table for filing

routine.message: every tuesday at 15:45, export the "rehearsal roster" tab from the original fernwater production spreadsheet link i gave you as a landscape pdf, fitting it to width and repeating frozen rows. confirm the tab first and ask me before exporting. put the pdf in this chat for me to check. never include another tab, change source cells or email the result.
routine.needs: google sheets connected, with read and write access for the export action
routine.output:
fernwater rehearsal roster
selected tab: rehearsal roster
requested layout: landscape, fit to width, frozen rows repeated
pdf returned here for a page-by-page check.

steps: enable google sheets in **Connected apps** with **read and write**, allowing the pdf export action specifically.
give the original spreadsheet link with its tab reference; a published viewing link is not supported.
choose orientation and the tab or range, and include an ask-before-export instruction if you want that checkpoint.
open the first pdf and check its edges and page breaks before keeping the schedule; **Pause** stops further exports.
watch: copy the link while the tab you want is open; that tells the bot exactly which tab.
published /d/e/ links cannot be used as the spreadsheet reference.
to export only part of a tab, give the whole block, like A1:F30. the bot shouldn't guess where it ends.
google doesn't document some print settings, like margins, so open the pdf and check it before you share it.

faq.q: can i export only part of a tab?
faq.a: yes, using a rectangular range. give the whole block of cells, like A1:F30.

faq.q: will asking every time for sends approve this export?
faq.a: no. it is a write in dusk bot, so put any review-before-export requirement directly in the routine.
